Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread and contradicted the evidence provided by WebSurfer (which clearly showed “Hey, Slavs” was Yugoslavia’s anthem from 1943–1992) and incorrectly concluded the anthem was adopted/used starting in 1992. This conflated the SFR Yugoslavia (adopted in 1943) with the later FR Yugoslavia (1992) and led directly to the wrong final answer.
